name: United Federation of Planets
description: The default assumed era of the Star Trek Adventures core rulebook: 2371, the years of The Next Generation's final seasons and Deep Space Nine and Voyager's early ones. A optimistic, post-scarcity interstellar government of over a hundred and fifty member worlds, explored and defended by Starfleet — an explicitly multi-species institution where a human helm officer, a Vulcan science officer, and a Bajoran first officer serve on the same bridge as a matter of course.
